'BlockMatrixVector.block_matrix_vector_product' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
theorem BlockMatrixVector.block_matrix_vector_product : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
  (T : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (e : BlockMatrixVector.Roundoff m),
  0 < T →
    0 ≤ u →
      BlockMatrixVector.Admissible n T u e →
        ↑(BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T) * u < 1 →
          ∃ ΔA,
            BlockMatrixVector.computedVector A x T e = (A + ΔA).mulVec x ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n),
                |ΔA i j| ≤ BlockMatrixVector.gamma (BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T) u * |A i j| :=
fun {m n} A x T u e hT hu hround hsmall =>
  Exists.intro (BlockMatrixVector.perturbation A T e)
    (BlockMatrixVector.constructed_backward_error A x T u e hT hu hround hsmall)
